dict.string: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor which runs on your desktop and is available for Windows, macOS and Linux.

#!/bin/bash
# Script to change ownership of the .vscode directory in each user's home directory
# Exit Codes # 0: Success # 95: Not running as root
# Variables LOG_PROCESS="fix_vscode_ownership"
#Functions writeLog() { # Write to system log /usr/bin/logger -is -t "${LOG_PROCESS}" "[${LOG_PROCESS}] ${1}" }
root_check() { if [[ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" != "0" ]] ; then writeLog "${LOG_PROCESS} MUST run as root..." exit 95 fi }
main() { # Get a list of all user directories in /Users, excluding some directories for USER in $(/usr/bin/dscl . -list /Users UniqueID | /usr/bin/awk '$2 > 500 { print $1 }'); do
# Define the user's home directory USER_DIR=$(/usr/bin/dscl . -read "/Users/${USER}" NFSHomeDirectory | awk '{print $2}')
# Define the .vscode directory path for this user VSCODE_DIR="${USER_DIR}/.vscode"
# Check if the .vscode directory exists if [[ -d "${VSCODE_DIR}" ]]; then writeLog "Changing ownership of ${VSCODE_DIR} to ${USER}" /usr/sbin/chown -R "${USER}":staff "${VSCODE_DIR}" else writeLog "Skipping: No .vscode directory found for ${USER}" fi
# Define the Code directory path for this user VSCODE_LIB_DIR="${USER_DIR}/Library/Application Support/Code"
# Check if the Code directory exists if [[ -d "${VSCODE_LIB_DIR}" ]]; then writeLog "Changing ownership of ${VSCODE_LIB_DIR} to ${USER}" /usr/sbin/chown -R "${USER}":staff "${VSCODE_LIB_DIR}" else writeLog "Skipping: No Code directory found for ${USER}" fi done }
# Main root_check main writeLog "${LOG_PROCESS} complete."
exit 0
